facts.builds: Bito Chess builds your opening repertoire, one line at a time.
facts.drills: It drills the moves you forget, and leaves alone the ones you know.
facts.review: Lines come back for review right before you would forget them.
facts.reads: It reads your games to find the openings you actually play.
facts.gaps: It spots the gaps — the replies you have no answer prepared for.
facts.mistakes: Your mistakes become training positions you can replay.
facts.engine: Play your openings against the engine, from any position.
facts.daily: A daily challenge mixes your lines, puzzles and past mistakes.
facts.puzzles: Puzzles are picked from the openings in your own repertoire.
facts.endgames: Endgames you reached in real games become practice positions.
facts.analyser: A built-in engine and analyser, no account needed.
facts.scout: Scout an opponent before you play them.
facts.phone: Everything works on your phone, and your data stays there.
facts.export: Export a full backup, or your lines as PGN, whenever you like.
firstRun.tooFewGames: There aren’t enough games there yet to find your openings. Start with a ready-made opening, or build your own line.
firstRun.pausedNote: {training} are training now; {paused} are saved paused in Openings → My lines.
firstRun.analysisRunning: Your game analysis keeps running, and we’ll let you know when it’s ready.
analysis.nothing: Game analysis finished: no clear mistakes in your games.
